title: Microservice Interface & Inter-Service Call Extraction
description: Canonical schema for Ground Truth and LLM Agent extraction of exposed microservice interfaces and cross-service call edges.

extractor_tool.description: Tool or curation source that produced this extraction.

prompt_version.description: Version tag of the extraction prompt used (e.g. 'v1.0').

microservices.description: Map from canonical microservice ID (must match keys in outputs/<MS_ID>/output.json) to its exposed interfaces.

inter_service_calls.description: Directed cross-service invocations where src_service != dst_service.

id.description: Unique identifier within the service, formatted as '<SimpleClassName>.<method_name>' (e.g. 'OwnerResource.findOwner').

class_name.description: Canonical class name from outputs/<MS_ID>/output.json declaring this interface operation.

method_name.description: Declared method or handler function name.

param_types.description: Ordered list of domain/payload parameter types (excluding framework context parameters like HttpServletRequest, gin.Context, CancellationToken).

return_type.description: Unwrapped domain return type (e.g. 'Owner', 'List<Visit>', 'void'; unwrap ResponseEntity<T>, Mono<T>, Task<ActionResult<T>> to T).

endpoint.description: HTTP verb + route path, gRPC service/method, or message topic/queue/channel.

src_service.description: Canonical caller microservice ID from output.json.

src_class.description: Canonical caller class name from output.json.

src_method.description: Method in src_class that initiates the cross-service call.

dst_service.description: Canonical target microservice ID from output.json (must differ from src_service).

dst_class.description: Canonical target class name in dst_service from output.json.

dst_interface_id.description: Target interface ID matching an entry in microservices[dst_service].exposed_interfaces (e.g. 'OwnerResource.findOwner').

protocol.description: Mechanism used for the cross-service invocation.

evidence.description: Concise code snippet or file:line reference proving the cross-service call.
